tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Retrieve the list of services and technologies offered by SynapseIndia. Use when the user asks what SynapseIndia does, what technologies are supported, or wants to compare service offerings.

category.description: Filter by service category. Use "all" to get the full list.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate to a specific section of the SynapseIndia website — services, about us, portfolio, blog, case studies, or contact.

tools.name: search_portfolio
tools.description: Search SynapseIndia's portfolio of past projects by technology, industry, or keyword. Use when a user asks about past work, case studies, or specific project examples.

query.description: Keyword, technology name, or industry to search for (e.g. "Shopify", "healthcare", "React")

industry.description: Industry filter (e.g. retail, healthcare, finance, education)

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submit a project enquiry or contact request to SynapseIndia. Use this when the user wants to hire SynapseIndia, request a quote, start a new software project, or get in touch with the sales team.

name.description: Full name of the person submitting the enquiry

service.description: Service category the user is interested in
